speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Paraneoplastic Cerebellar Degeneration.

The asymmetry of your symptoms (worsening on the right side) combined with the acute onset of "drunken" gait and limb clumsiness strongly suggests a paraneoplastic syndrome rather than a primary neurodegenerative disorder or stroke. Given the lack of focal sensory loss or pain, this points toward an autoimmune attack on the cerebellum often triggered by an underlying malignancy, such as ovarian or lung cancer.
